content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Research Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is one of the following: PhD Master's degree in Engineering/ technology or MSc (Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Data Science and Artificial Intelligence/ Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Electrical Engineering) with 3 years experience and at least one journal publication The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted. Eligible candidates are notified by email and invited for the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for 3 months on a contract basis. It may be extendable up to nine months, based on performance and availability of fund.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form annexed to the notice. Gather soft copies of the filled form, your most recent CV, and the mark sheets/certificates that support your academic qualification and experience. Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document. Email the PDF to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] . Use the subject line "Application for Research Associate In MoSPI Project". The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photograph submitted. Applicants already employed in government or any other organization must also submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview, along with the documents above.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply with a Master's degree or MSc?
faq.answer: Yes, if the degree matches the fields listed in the notice and you also have 3 years experience and at least one journal publication.

faq.question: Q2. Are the experience and publication conditions printed for PhD holders?
faq.answer: No. PhD is listed as the first essential option, and the 3 years experience and journal publication are printed with the Master's degree or MSc option.

faq.question: Q3. How long will the engagement last?
faq.answer: It starts at 3 months and may be extendable up to nine months, depending on performance and availability of fund.

faq.question: Q4. In what format should I send my documents?
faq.answer: All soft copies may be consolidated into a single PDF document, which goes by email with the subject line given in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be notified by email after shortlisting and invited for the online interview on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. I am already employed. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: You must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from your employer at the time of interview, whether you work in government or any other organization.

faq.question: Q7. Can the qualification or experience requirement be relaxed?
faq.answer: The Institute reserves the right to relax both for candidates with exceptional credentials.
